messages:
alex: Canary rolled to 5% ~10m ago. Noticed increase in KV cache evictions and tail latency in us-east-1. Sample tilt: ~80% of affected requests from edge-2. Anyone else seeing this? /cc @lina @jamie

deploy-bot: deploybot: rollout 2026-03-20T15:22Z -> model-serving:v3.4.1 started; canary=5% across us-east-1,eu-west-1

jamie: Looking at traces — same pattern, kvcache miss rate x3, p95 +230ms. Errors not spiking yet. Likely memory pressure on shard nodes handling prefix caching.

lina: ops-oncall digging in: one host in us-east-1-edge-2 showing repeated OOM_kv_eviction entries. Autoscaler kicked but we're seeing cache thrash. Suggest soft-reduce to 1% and drain that shard. Thoughts?

alex: Pin to 1% sounds safe. Are we pinned in deploy config or need manual rollback? Need a clear rollback plan if errors climb.

ben: Two quick options: scale canary down (`deploy-bot scale --percent 1 --target canary/2026-03-20`) or rollback canary to previous model (`deploy-bot rollback --to model-serving:v3.4.0 --scope canary`). Which do we prefer?

jamie: I prefer reduce to 1% first so we avoid churn from a rollback. If metrics don't stabilize in 10m -> rollback canary to v3.4.0 and prepare for full rollback.

lina: +1. I'll start draining the problematic host and taint it for scheduling so new replicas don't land there.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Scaling canary from 5% -> 1% now. Progress: 40%...80%...done.

alex: Thanks. Jamie's dashboard shows p95 dropped from +230ms -> +80ms after scale. Not perfect but much better. Let's hold at 1% for 15m and re-evaluate.

ben: Can we also pin routing so critical customers aren't hit by canary? I recommend excluding top enterprise routes: `reroute --exclude-accounts acct-1234,acct-5678,acct-9012`.

lina: Done. Excluded the top three enterprise accounts from canary routing. Also created ticket INC-2026-045 to track infra remediation and KV cache tuning.

jamie: Vote: hold=:+1: continue=:-1:? I'm +hold.

alex: +hold. Lina: +hold. Ben: +hold.

deploy-bot: note: canary sample reduced, excluded routes applied. Logged rollout event in internal changelog: https://redwood.internal/release/2026-03-20/v3.4.1 and created audit entry.

alex: We'll reconvene at +15m or earlier if alerts. If regressions reappear we'll rollback canary to v3.4.0 and pin v3.4.0 in prod. Holding for now.
